subject: gk
question: How many layers of structures consist of the cell envelope?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Three**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **cell envelope of a cell is made up of three layers: **

 
 
• **Outer membrane:** The outermost layer
 
• **Peptidoglycan cell wall**: The middle layer
 
• **Cytoplasmic or inner membrane**: The innermost layer
 
 
 
• The **two concentric membrane layers create a cellular compartment called the periplasm**.
 
• The **composition of the glycocalyx, the outermost layer, varies between different types of bacteria**.
 
• A loose sheath-like glycocalyx is called a slime layer, while a thick and tough one is called a capsule. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cell Envelope**
 
• The cell envelope** is made up of the cell wall, cell membrane, and outer membrane.**
 
• The **cell envelope of Gram-positive bacteria includes a cell wall, cytoplasmic membrane, and capsule.**
 
• In contrast, the cell envelope of Gram-negative bacteria includes a cell wall, cytoplasmic membrane, outer membrane, periplasmic space, and capsule.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d949c9035a8ad46410738e47d114a336474674785e4882b5c930a6e6cf4c4e7f.jpg]
